Thank you for your request under Guideline 2.1 — Information Needed.

For Prelis Desktop for macOS, version 0.1.4, build [SUBMITTED_MACOS_BUILD_NUMBER], we are providing a physical-Mac demonstration and the requested information in App Review Information > Notes: the app's purpose and audience, setup and access instructions, external services/tools, regional behavior, and regulated services/protected material.

Video: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UXEAS0PZdQHwsaTuCJzzj6qZ4Oxu1c7i/view?usp=sharing
Recorded/tested on November 3, 2026: MacBook Air (Apple silicon), macOS 27.2 (26B123).
Duration: approximately 1 minute 43 seconds, with application audio.

The video demonstrates the app's three main features:
00:00–00:11 — Diary: enter and save sample text, reopen it after restarting the app, and clear the test entry.
00:11–00:25 — Password: generate and copy passwords, change character types and lengths, and exclude ambiguous characters.
00:25–01:43 — Timer: select and preview a sound, run a one-minute countdown, hear the completion sound, and reset to stop playback.

Testing confirmed saved diary content after restarting the app, the generated passwords and copied clipboard contents, and the timer's preview/completion audio and reset behavior.

The app is available to general users without an account, login credentials, subscription, or in-app purchase. Diary entries and imported sounds are stored locally. Core features work offline without an external backend, and functionality is consistent across distribution regions.

Notes includes instructions for all three features, the sample audio, and the privacy policy accessible from the sidebar.

Thank you for reviewing our submission.
